metadata.description: The Magic School Bus is an American-Canadian animated children's television series, based on the book series of the same name by Joanna Cole and Bruce Degen. Running originally from 1994 to 1997, the series received critical acclaim for its use of celebrity voice talent such as Malcolm-Jamal Warner and combining entertainment with an educational series. Broadcasting & Cable writer explained the show was "among the highest-rated PBS shows for school-age children" in 1997.

reviews.reviewbody: Sure was a good PBS cartoon.

reviews.reviewtitle: Ms. Frizzle is at it again!!!
reviews.reviewbody: So this show is educational and is a good learning experience for everyone, except some people. You get it. The reasoning behind the magic of the bus is never really explained, but magic is magic and part of the magic is not knowing why it functions as it does. The story has something important to say, like in that one episode where they drink down and go inside the body of the orange headed kid and like scr*w with his white blood cells for a lot of reasons. Also the orange headed kid takes his astronaut helmet off and freezes to death in space but they kinda get over it. Great show.
